analysis: The code snippet is within a method `resize` that creates a new backing array `newItems` using `ArrayReflection.newInstance` with the component type of the current array `items`. Then it calls `System.arraycopy(items, 0, newItems, 0, Math.min(size, newItems.length))`. Here, `items` is the existing non-null array, `newItems` is freshly created and also non-null, so `NullPointerException` is avoided. The source position and destination position are both 0, and the length is the minimum of `size` (the number of elements currently used) and `newItems.length` (the new capacity). Since `size <= items.length` (by invariant), the copy will not exceed `items.length`, and `length <= newItems.length`, so `IndexOutOfBoundsException` is avoided. Both arrays have the same component type (obtained via reflection), so there is no primitive/reference mismatch, and actual elements are of that type, so `ArrayStoreException` is avoided. Therefore, all declared exceptions are avoided by the context.
